The rank of '''Senior Commander''' was a rank used within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Senior Commander was a rank within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] among the Clones, in particular, it acted as the second-highest rank among the clones, with only [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] outranking it.

[[Hamelin]] served as a senior commander for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|11|Hamelin}}</ref>

This line rank was used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It ranked above [[Junior Commander/Legends|Junior Commander]], and below [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]]. Senior Commanders could hold a position of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] ([[Starship/Legends|starship]] commanding officer) or [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] (ship officer crew). The rank was the equivalent of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] [[Major/Legends|Major]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Not long after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], The [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera''{{'s}}]] [[Grondarle]] held this rank in the capacity of the ship's [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]].

==Behind the scenes==
It appears that Senior Commander denotes a substantive rank than than a title of primacy as in the novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', Grondarle is explicitly described as "The first officer, Senior Commander Grondarle", the capitalization of Senior Commander denoting a substantive rank in comparison to the lower-case for "first officer", a title denoting a position of executive seniority.
